title: Small test payment followed by a large one
summary: A trivial payment of a few rupees went to a new receiver and was approved. Six minutes later the same receiver was sent a very large amount. The small payment was the attacker confirming the stolen credentials worked.
signals: the money is going to a receiver never used before
an unusual number of transactions in a short time
the amount is many times this customer's usual payment
resolution: Second payment blocked. The first, trivial payment was not recovered and was not worth pursuing.
lesson: A tiny payment to a new receiver is not harmless — it is often reconnaissance. The pattern is only visible if you link the two payments.
